source.title: Team Georgia 'State of Georgia Holiday Schedule' (2026 and 2027, per Gov. Kemp's annual holiday memo); georgia.gov 'Georgia State Holidays 2026'; DOAS state holiday events

stateHolidays.name: State Holiday (Good Friday)
stateHolidays.note: Unnamed 'State Holiday' observed on Good Friday (Apr 3, 2026; Mar 26, 2027; Apr 18, 2025). Pre-2015 this slot was Confederate Memorial Day (April 26 / 4th Monday in April); renamed 'State Holiday' by Gov. Deal in 2015, later settled on Good Friday. No longer carries a Confederate name or date.

stateHolidays.name: State Holiday (Friday after Thanksgiving)
stateHolidays.note: Unnamed 'State Holiday' (Nov 27, 2026; Nov 26, 2027). Pre-2015 this was Robert E. Lee's Birthday observance; renamed 'State Holiday' in 2015. No longer carries a Confederate name.

stateHolidays.name: Washington's Birthday (moved to Christmas week)
stateHolidays.rule: other:Washington's Birthday holiday is observed on a weekday adjacent to Christmas, set annually by the Governor (Fri Dec 26 in 2025, Thu Dec 24 in 2026, Thu Dec 23 in 2027)
stateHolidays.note: Official lists show 'Washington's Birthday: Monday, February 16 - will be observed Thursday, December 24' (2026). The Feb Monday is a normal workday.
